comment:
* The callback that links {@link AsyncListUtil} with the list view. * *

* All methods are called on the main thread.

variables.name: HINT_SCROLL_DESC
variables.comment:
* Scrolling in descending order (from higher to lower positions in the order of the backing
         * storage).

variables.name: HINT_SCROLL_ASC
variables.comment:
* Scrolling in ascending order (from lower to higher positions in the order of the backing
         * storage).

methods.name: public abstract void getItemRangeInto(int @NonNull [] outRange)
methods.comment:
* Compute the range of visible item positions. *

* outRange[0] is the position of the first visible item (in the order of the backing * storage). *

* outRange[1] is the position of the last visible item (in the order of the backing * storage). *

* Negative positions and positions greater or equal to {@link #getItemCount} are invalid. * If the returned range contains invalid positions it is ignored (no item will be loaded). * * @param outRange The visible item range.

methods.name: public void extendRangeInto(int @NonNull [] range, int @NonNull [] outRange, int scrollHint)
methods.comment:
* Compute a wider range of items that will be loaded for smoother scrolling. * *

* If there is no scroll hint, the default implementation extends the visible range by half * its length in both directions. If there is a scroll hint, the range is extended by * its full length in the scroll direction, and by half in the other direction. *

* For example, if range is {100, 200} and scrollHint * is {@link #HINT_SCROLL_ASC}, then outRange will be {50, 300}. *

* However, if scrollHint is {@link #HINT_SCROLL_NONE}, then * outRange will be {50, 250} * * @param range Visible item range. * @param outRange Extended range. * @param scrollHint The scroll direction hint.

methods.name: public abstract void onDataRefresh()
methods.comment: * Called when the entire data set has changed.

methods.name: public abstract void onItemLoaded(int position)
methods.comment:
* Called when an item at the given position is loaded.
         * @param position Item position.

methodNames: public void extendRangeInto(int @NonNull [] range, int @NonNull [] outRange, int scrollHint)
